request.style: English, Female solo voice, warm and narrative, piano, cello, soft drums, strings, ambient pad, reverent and hopeful mood, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
A daughter of Levi in Egypt lived
Amram married her, the covenant kept
She bore Aaron and Miriam too
Moses came when the decree stood
The king commanded to kill the boys
But she saw the beauty of the child's face

[Pre-Chorus]
She hid him for three full months
Not afraid of the king's heavy command
Faith stood strong in the land
When she could hide him no longer

[Chorus]
She made a basket of papyrus
Coated with tar and pitch
Laid the child in it gently
Set it among the reeds on the Nile

[Verse]
His sister stood at a distance
Watching to see what would be
Pharaoh's daughter came to the river
To bathe by the water's edge
She saw the basket in the reeds
Sent her slave girl to fetch it

[Chorus]
She made a basket of papyrus
Coated with tar and pitch
Laid the child in it gently
Set it among the reeds on the Nile

[Bridge]
She opened it and saw the boy
Crying, a baby boy
She felt sorry for him
Said this is one of the Hebrew children

[Verse]
His sister asked to find a nurse
A Hebrew woman to help
Pharaoh's daughter agreed and said
Go, find her and bring her here
Jochebed came and took the child
Nursed him for wages paid

[Chorus]
She made a basket of papyrus
Coated with tar and pitch
Laid the child in it gently
Set it among the reeds on the Nile

[Outro]
By faith his parents hid him
Not afraid of the king's edict
A faithful mother of Levi
Saw the beauty of God's plan
